+@pytest.mark.parametrize("raise_in_context", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.anyio
+async def test_request_form_context_manager_closes_files(raise_in_context: bool) -> None:
+    body = (
+        b"--boundary\r\n"
+        b'Content-Disposition: form-data; name="files"; filename="one.txt"\r\n'
+        b"Content-Type: text/plain\r\n\r\n"
+        b"one\r\n"
+        b"--boundary\r\n"
+        b'Content-Disposition: form-data; name="files"; filename="two.txt"\r\n'
+        b"Content-Type: text/plain\r\n\r\n"
+        b"two\r\n"
+        b"--boundary--\r\n"
+    )
+
+    async def receive() -> Message:
+        return {"type": "http.request", "body": body}
+
+    request = Request(
+        {
+            "type": "http",
+            "method": "POST",
+            "path": "/",
+            "headers": [(b"content-type", b"multipart/form-data; boundary=boundary")],
+        },
+        receive,
+    )
+    uploads: list[UploadFile] = []
+
+    async def use_form() -> None:
+        async with request.form() as form:
+            uploads.extend(value for _, value in form.multi_items() if isinstance(value, UploadFile))
+            assert len(uploads) == 2
+            assert all(not upload.file.closed for upload in uploads)
+            if raise_in_context:
+                raise RuntimeError("context body failed")
+
+    if raise_in_context:
+        with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="context body failed"):
+            await use_form()
+    else:
+        await use_form()
+
+    assert all(upload.file.closed for upload in uploads)
+
